title: Uniform bounds on preorder bar totals
statement: For a small preorder diagram D of integer cochain complexes and its bar total [def-sc-preorder-bar-total], suppose every D(j) vanishes in degrees q>b for one integer b. Then the bar total also vanishes in every degree n>b.

source.place: The source-bar, finite-cone-block, least-block adjunction and union-bar paragraphs; Uniform bounds on preorder bar totals.

proof.text: The term in degree n is a coproduct indexed by p>=0 and q-p=n, and then by the bar strings. If n>b, then q=n+p>b. All its summands are zero objects, so the coproduct is zero.
